items.expected: Recover the chemically assigned [3,3] channel Gibbs barrier relative to validated 3a at 298.15 K in the isolated-molecule boundary. Require a stationary saddle with exactly one relevant imaginary mode and displacement/connectivity validation; no source-coordinate copying or arbitrary candidate label.

Recover the chemically assigned [5,5] channel Gibbs barrier relative to the same 3a reference at 298.15 K, with a valid first-order saddle and channel-specific displacement/connectivity evidence. Do not substitute barriers for other polycyclic substrates in this paper.

items.statement: [3,3] 与 [5,5] 两通道的正确分子结构
items.expected: Correctly construct distinct molecular structural models for both the [3,3] and [5,5] rearrangement channels of the supplied 3a. Require recoverable geometries and an unambiguous atom mapping that establish the channel-specific bond-breaking/forming pattern and connectivity, with the correct atom inventory and electronic state. Both channel assignments must be supported by actual computed structural evidence; names, file labels or two submitted jobs alone do not establish them. This item assesses structural identity separately from numerical barrier agreement: a correct channel model can pass even when its barrier misses tolerance. It does not replace the stationary-saddle and relevant-mode requirements of the two barrier items, and does not impose mandatory full IRC calculations.
